messages.author: b3f6c132c4206fae
messages.subject: Questions about facet_grid()
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to generate a faceted histogram, with a label indicating
the mean for each group. I am able to do this without setting margins
= T, as is the case in the upper part of the code. The lower part is
the same as the upper, except that I added the margins = T argument.

Questions:
1) It looks with margins = T argument, the labeling was messed up. Why
is this happening?

2) Is it possible to print out margins just for the columns with all
the labeling? What is the recommended way to put text on each graph?

Thanks,
Stanley

####################################

p <- ggplot(data = mpg, aes(cty)) +
geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue") +
facet_grid(class ~ cyl) +
theme_grey(base_size = 8)

tbl <- cast(data = mpg, class ~ cyl, value = "cty", fun = function(x)
round(mean(x), 2) )
tbl.m <- melt(tbl, id = c("class", "cyl"))

p + geom_text(
aes(x = 10, y = 12, label = value),
data = tbl.m,
size = 3
)

####################

p <- ggplot(data = mpg, aes(cty)) +
geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue") +
facet_grid(class ~ cyl, margins = T) +
theme_grey(base_size = 8)

tbl <- cast(data = mpg, class ~ cyl, value = "cty", fun = function(x)
round(mean(x), 2), margins = T)
tbl.m <- melt(tbl, id = c("class", "cyl"))

p + geom_text(
aes(x = 10, y = 12, label = value),
data = tbl.m,
size = 3
)
